execution_order: Reconcile tracker statuses and revision-compatible evidence; preserve all prior PASS results absent contradictory evidence.
Select the next NOT_TESTED read-only criterion by journey priority and existing dependencies; do not reopen unchanged PASS criteria.
Record precondition and exact criterion; perform UI actions only in the existing claimed tab(s), using semantic locators.
Capture the smallest sufficient UI/state evidence; use screenshots for visual/responsive/failure evidence and network diagnostics only when criterion needs them.
For financial criteria, use existing read-only Admin/Backend/Ledger/Events evidence; never infer durable success from a button, HTTP success, or toast.
Update only the existing CSV row and linked evidence after observation; keep ID, precondition, action, UI result, network/state evidence, status, and evidence location.
After one focused safe retry, record persistent blockers and continue independent authorized criteria.
Recount the 113-row tracker, verify evidence references, and save a compact continuation checkpoint.
journey_scope: Spot, Margin, Binary/Options, Convert, Mining, and Loans
Accessibility, visual quality, errors, and reconnection

never: retry uncertain financial submission before reconciliation

status_rules.PASS: Observed expected behavior with criterion-sufficient evidence.
status_rules.FAIL: Observed behavior contradicts the criterion with evidence.
status_rules.BLOCKED: Execution is prevented by a concrete prerequisite or authorization boundary.
status_rules.NOT_TESTED: No current execution evidence; documentation or old procedure alone is insufficient.

ui_ux: rendered hierarchy, control state, readability, focus/target geometry, visual consistency
selective_intelligence: avoid duplicated discovery and unsupported completion claims
annotations_extensibility: apply only if annotation controls or feedback surface is part of an acceptance criterion; otherwise not applicable
exa: official primary-source lookup only for uncertain standards or API behavior; avoid repeated unchanged research
